review.attribution: Each student PDF set is bound by exact SHA-256 to a passing independent review by a different agent than its author (fifteen Claude Opus 5.5 reviews of Astra, Antigravity and Kimi sets; claude007 for G7-EQN-02). G9-PYD-01 also carries a delta review of a report-only rebuild whose PDFs are byte-identical to the reviewed ones. This integration rechecks the byte pins and media downloads and does not claim a new full math or visual review.
retainedLimits: PDF publication only. Word files, private keys, didactic notes, hints and native exports stay outside the site.
G9-PYD-01 is a reduced-track (ט׳ מצומצמת) series by its package metadata and official-layout source; its printed header says only כיתה ט׳.
Eleven producer v72 reports stay at REVIEW for G94 page density only (no other gate is below PASS); each independent reviewer accepted those pages.
Producer prefixes are provenance only; no new native assets, viewer routing, teacher selection, learning identities or AI activation.
